messages:
alex: forwarding a support ticket from ACME — rerank results are wrong after update. Customer says ordering flipped and some candidates show null metadata.

alex: customer payload they sent:
```json
{
  "query": "best email subject",
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "a1", "text": "Option A", "metadata": null},
    {"id": "a2", "text": "Option B", "score": "0.87"},
    {"id": null, "text": "Option C", "score": 0.92}
  ]
}
```

maria: thx — sounds like two issues: 1) scores coming through as strings, 2) null id/metadata injection. Can you share SDK version and sample client code?

ryan: I can repro with ts-sdk@1.4.2. Bug introduced in v1.4.0 when we normalized optional fields. Repro (node 18):
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.rerank({
  query: 'x',
  candidates: [{ id: 'a', text: 'A', metadata: undefined }, { id: 'b', text: 'B' }]
});
```
This ends up sending `{"id":null, ...}` because our normalization step coerces undefined -> null before stringify. Also saw a change that forces numeric scores to strings in some callers. Working on a patch. :construction:

eva: ML note — our reranker expects `score` as a number. If it sees a string it does `parseFloat` which can return NaN for weird formats, then fallback behavior treats that candidate as lower priority, explaining ordering flips.

maria: customer also reported intermittent 400s when payload had ~60 candidates and some null fields. Validator rejects null `id` values.

ryan: created PR with fix to filter undefined fields and coerce numeric-like score strings to numbers before send: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-sdk/pull/2345 
Hotfix plan: cut ts-sdk@1.4.3 and py-sdk@0.9.9 patch release in next 2 hours, deploy to hosted and notify Dedicated customers.

maria: workaround for customers in meantime: sanitize candidates client-side before call:
```py
def sanitize(cands):
  return [ {k:v for k,v in c.items() if v is not None and v != ''} for c in cands ]
```
Or in JS:
```js
const clean = candidates.map(c => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(c).filter(([_,v])=>v!==undefined && v!==null && v !== "")));
client.rerank({ query, candidates: clean });
```

alex: forwarding the repro, patch link, and workaround to the customer. I'll update the ticket with ETA. :thumbsup:

support-bot: incident created INC-7654 and linked ticket TCK-9981

ryan: deployed hotfix to staging, running integration test against rerank schema now. Will post when live in prod.
